build_speech_to_text_pipeline: build a speech-to-text pipeline using SpeechToTextModelPipeline with encoder, decoder, and tokenizer names
build_speech_to_embedding_pipeline: build a speech-to-embedding pipeline using SpeechToEmbeddingModelPipeline with an encoder name and device
run_speech_to_text_prediction: run speech-to-text prediction on audio file paths or tensors with SpeechToTextModelPipeline.predict
run_speech_to_embedding_prediction: run speech-to-embedding prediction on audio file paths or tensors with SpeechToEmbeddingModelPipeline.predict
build_audio_to_fbank_pipeline: build an audio-to-fbank data pipeline using AudioToFbankDataPipelineBuilder from a TSV data file
